title: On the rank-one limit sets for maps in the constant-Jacobian shear group of $\mathbb{C}^2$
summary: Let $\mathcal{S}_c$ be the subgroup of $Aut(\mathbb{C}^2)$ generated by affine maps and shear automorphisms with constant Jacobian. We determine the possible conformal types of the rank-one limit set of an invariant recurrent Fatou component when the induced dynamics has infinite order. In particular we show that, under this infinite-order hypothesis, the limit set of a finite composition of Hénon maps (polynomial or transcendental), can only be conformally equivalent to a disk or an annulus.
